label: PF Backlog 452
title: EPIC: PF parallel run engine (per-item assignment + parallel validation + optimistic delivery; WorkerGrid = thin runtime host)
body:
Design locked 2026-10-07 (user-approved). Goal: burn the PF backlog in PARALLEL - many items per project
AND many projects - and generalize to intake -> analyze -> execute/schedule -> validate -> deliver for the PF
backlog and every project backlog. Today this is throttled to ONE item per project by job_manager's per-project job.

Target architecture: PF = single authority + parallel run engine (per-item assignment, run-scoped parallel
validation, optimistic delivery, assignments view). WorkerGrid = thin runtime host (/wg work; no server, no
lease, no store). A run = (scope, project, item, run_id) with its own worktree + evidence + concurrency slot.

Decisions: (1) extend the EXISTING single claimer (job_manager) to per-item - no second claim engine;
(2) delivery is an ASYNC lane; (3) auth = dedicated `worker` role (least privilege, no new store);
(4) keep the WorkerGrid coordinator as the fallback for non-PF producers.

IMPACT: the only non-aligned verdict is ADR-0002 (WorkerGrid owns registry/lease) - intentionally superseded by
a new ADR (coordination authority lives in the producer; WorkerGrid is a runtime host). No new stores (lease
stays in backlog.execution{}, single writer core/backlog.py); no duplicate engines (reuse vcs/validation_engine/
github/gates/capacity). Children: per-item claim+API, parallel validation, optimistic delivery, assignments
view+dedup, WorkerGrid thin client, ADR+docs.

Related: BI-PF-0360 (backlog SSOT + scheduler + pluggable workers epic), BI-PF-0347 (ENG-6 validation engine),
BI-PF-0381 (delivery provenance write-back).

## Scope decision (user, 2026-10-07)
The WorkerGrid worker path (assignment API + delivery lane) is for **Product Forge's OWN backlog
(`product_forge` scope / `BI-PF-*`) ONLY**. A generated product's change/backlog goes through **PF's regular
agents/pipeline** (native, per-project), never through a worker. Consequence: the assignment API must be
restricted to `product_forge` (fail-closed for `project`), and the PF-repo **runner clone** for delivery is
REQUIRED (not optional) because the sole worker scope lands in the PF repo.

decisions.decision: Worker/assignment/delivery = product_forge scope only; project-scope changes use PF's pipeline/agents. Restrict the assignment API; runner clone required.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_runtime.py, core/context_engine.py, core/discovery_engine.py, core/engineering_flow.py

_note: parallel run engine delivered: 0419 per-item claim, 0420 parallel validation, 0421/0428 optimistic delivery, 0422 assignments view + dedup, 0423 thin PF client, 0427 worker=product_forge only, 0424 ADR-0003

dashboard_impact.reason: Operator surface is /wg status + the PF API (assignments view); the dashboard is a separate surface and stays out of this slice
